text:
maya: quick proposal — we should collect a very tiny sampled preflight from ingest to estimate per-tenant embed dim+byte distribution before splitting. idea is ~1-5% sampling so we can tune routing + soft quotas without full preflight overhead.

TJ: +1. sampling sounds promising to reduce console surprises. how would this affect latency? :thinking:

maya: sampling only for telemetry, not on-path routing. real requests still go through splitter. sample packets tagged and processed async by the metrics pipeline. overhead ~0 for real path.

sasha: curious — how do we avoid gaming? malicious clients could send tiny vectors to skew samples. need sampling keyed by tenant and maybe rate-limited.

maya: good call. plan: sample by hashed request-id + tenant salt so clients can't trigger different sampling rates. also cap sampled bytes per-minute per-tenant.

hiro: do we have an initial schema for the sampled payload? we want dims, total_bytes, tokenized_size (for text->embed variability), and perhaps encoder-version.

maya: prototype schema (very small):

```
X-Embed-Sample: 0.02
X-Embed-Preflight: sampled
{
  "tenant_id": "t_123",
  "sample_id": "uuid",
  "requested_dims": 1536,
  "payload_bytes": 812,
  "inputs": 1,
  "model_hint": "all-mpnet-lite",
  "encoder_version": "v3"
}
```

neal: love this. downstream we can feed samples into a rolling quantile calculator and produce percentile-based soft-quotas in the console. helps set per-tenant suggestions (split-to-2, prefer-quant8).

TJ: telemetry pipeline question — sampling rate changes will change quotas. we need UI to indicate sample coverage (e.g., "Based on 2.1% of requests — 95th dim = 1536"). Otherwise SRE will get paged.

sasha: +1 for visibility. Also suggest a confidence metric (samples/sec and unique-days) rather than raw counts.

maya: UX notes: console should surface a new "Embed Shape Insights" panel with: sample coverage, dim histogram, avg bytes, suggested split strategy, and a one-click apply to route policy (create or patch a soft-routing rule).

hiro: can we add a preview API that runs the suggested routing decision against recent requests (dry-run) and shows expected split count and cost delta?

maya: yes — backend can run the rule against sample set and compute expected extra RPCs and estimated token cost. show delta as % latency/cost.

console-bot: saved dashboard "Embed Shape Insights (sampled)" — panel added: dim_histogram, sample_coverage, suggested_split.

neal: rollout plan: start opt-in for internal tenants for 2 weeks, then opt-in orgs, finally default-on with opt-out. add audit log entries for sample-rate changes.

TJ: one more risk — privacy. ensure sampled payloads are non-sensitive: we should avoid storing raw inputs, only aggregate numbers and hashed sample_id. redact any text fields by default. Legal ok?

maya: agreed. only store numeric metadata and hashed ids. will coordinate with security/legal for retention window (30d) and deletion hooks.

sasha: action items: (1) infra spike to emit X-Embed-Sample header and async collector (maya + hiro), (2) telemetry aggregator to build quantiles and retention (neal), (3) console panel mockups (sasha), (4) rollout doc + privacy checklist (maya).

maya: I'll open the PR for the sampling header and a tiny collector lambda today. ping @tj for telemetry schema review.

TJ: will review this afternoon. thanks! :thumbsup:
